description_en: Uploads audio over WebSocket and receives recognized text, agent responses, and synthesized audio. Supports auxiliary image and text input, recognition context, and session history. The operation description covers the complete handshake, control frames, audio frames, response events, and error handling protocols
description_zh: 通过 WebSocket 上传语音并接收识别文字、Agent 回复及合成音频，支持图文辅助输入、识别上下文和会话历史。接口说明包含完整握手、控制帧、音频帧、返回事件与错误处理协议
name: StreamVoice

parameters.help_en: The lower camel case back-to-origin protocol is fixed to aliyun-roa. When omitted, the legacy protocol is used. Does not participate in HMAC signing
parameters.help_zh: 小驼峰回源协议固定传 aliyun-roa，省略时为旧协议；不参与 HMAC 签名
parameters.name: x_gw_protocol

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the business gateway
parameters.help_zh: 业务网关 Access Key ID
parameters.name: x_gw_access

parameters.help_zh: 当前 Unix 毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: x_gw_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The random string used for each call
parameters.help_zh: 每次调用使用的随机串
parameters.name: x_gw_nonce

parameters.help_en: The HMAC-SHA256 lowercase hexadecimal signature calculated based on the actual request bytes
parameters.help_zh: 按实际请求字节计算的 HMAC-SHA256 小写十六进制签名
parameters.name: x_gw_signature

parameters.help_en: The optional connection-level correlation ID. When omitted, a server-side diagnostic ID is generated. When explicitly provided, only one 1-128 character [A-Za-z0-9._:-] string is allowed. The gw-ingress- prefix is reserved for the service. Returns HTTP 400 if the format is invalid or multiple values are provided. Use run-task.communication.requestId for the business request ID of each turn
parameters.help_zh: 可选连接级关联号。省略时生成服务端诊断号。显式提供时只允许一个 1–128 位的 [A-Za-z0-9._:-] 字符串，gw-ingress- 前缀保留给服务。格式非法或提供多个值时返回 HTTP 400。每轮业务请求号使用 run-task.communication.requestId
parameters.name: x_request_id

schema.description_en: HTTP 101 indicates that the connection is upgraded. When the egress gateway rejects the upgrade, you can record the X-Request-Id or the request correlation ID in the error body
schema.description_zh: HTTP 101 表示连接已升级。外输网关拒绝升级时，可记录 X-Request-Id 或错误体中的请求关联号

RequestId.description_en: Used to troubleshoot the HTTP handshake. After the WebSocket upgrade, use communication.requestId in the VoiceEvent text frame to associate the interactive voice response of the current turn
RequestId.description_zh: 用于排查 HTTP 握手。WebSocket 升级后用 VoiceEvent 文本帧中的 communication.requestId 关联本轮语音交互
